protocol.quantile_rule: floor(q*(n-1)), all offered outcomes; failure mass at infinity
protocol.primary_score: Per policy and block, max over five cutoffs of the mean absolute all-offer error across rates4/8; six blocks
protocol.primary_family: Two matched-policy accuracy intervals; Bonferroni coverage >=95% conditional on independent approximately normal block scores. Calibration uncertainty not propagated.
protocol.population: All offers under the declared quota including throttling
protocol.failed_offers: Misses at every finite deadline; no success-only renormalization
protocol.observers: Original stock client/cgroup controls, policy boundary readbacks and CPU3 procstat; no worker sampler
